summary: P1.2 remains fail-closed. V99 lands a small close-kernel contract: every proof-bearing CERTIFIED / INFEASIBLE status surface in the current default certified_exact scan roots must be registered, source-hash sealed, bound to a proof obligation, and guarded; any new or drifted strong-status sink reopens the close claim.

step_7_contract.policy: Every Step 7 evaluator must fail closed unless the side-effect-free Step 6 attach decision is ATTACH. HOLD and QUARANTINE are both non-pruning states in the hot path.

source_digest_contract.runtime_cache_policy: Only explicitly declared runtime cache keys may be ignored by the source digest. Schema-valid authoritative keys that begin with '__' remain proof-carrying source facts. Validators that build runtime caches must rebuild or invalidate them from the canonical source payload.

obligations.title: Step 7 hot-path evaluation mirrors Step 6 attachability
Validator/generator source facts are covered by one source-digest contract
Runtime caches cannot become hidden proof sources
Exact-safe BendersCut replay is strictly typed, all-or-nothing, and faithfully encoded by the master
The certified master domain and power-witness representation match the full-domain contract before session construction
Certified terminal status requires strict full-frontier exhaustion evidence, not a candidate-level incumbent or best-effort stop
Certified export surfaces only expose artifacts after terminal full-frontier evidence is committed
obligations.policy: Persisted exact-safe cuts cannot be replayed as partial or stronger constraints. Strict payload parsing, canonical condition-key parsing, condition/metadata self-consistency, candidate-domain resolver support, explicit full unfiltered master-domain state, condition resolution, member resolution, literal de-aliasing, strict declare_mode terminal evidence, candidate-frontier completeness, terminal search_exhausted_all_candidates evidence, pre-session unsafe master-domain/power-representation env guards, and apply-before-register atomicity are all part of the certified replay boundary. Resume/import, inspector/report, wrapper, and manifest export boundaries must all reuse the terminal full-frontier certified evidence predicate and fail closed on missing, stale, malformed, or contradictory CERTIFIED evidence. Blocker paths that reset certified evidence must also purge stale delivery artifacts and refresh the manifest so stale filesystem surfaces cannot outlive the current fail-closed state. Terminal-state-first export must roll back certified state and purge partial artifacts if final artifact or manifest export fails. Manifest/artifact currentness must compare the raw final artifacts against the canonical projection, not a normalized subset; metadata.export_timestamp is the only ignored manifest metadata field, and terminal routing payloads must either project to optimal_blueprint.routing_network or fail closed. Blocker cleanup must run even when checkpoint rewrite fails, so a stale manifest/artifact set cannot be left as the only readable certified surface. Public certified read surfaces must consume the centralized certified_surface_verifier_v1 verdict, which binds campaign terminal evidence, exact artifact hashes, final_solution, optimal_blueprint, and the delivery manifest into one publishable gate and rejects non-regular manifest paths. V73 centralizes public CERTIFIED publication through src/search/certified_surface.py, so inspector and B5A consume one publishable verdict instead of local sibling predicates. V74 tightens the central verifier authority boundary: public certified surfaces must load the campaign checkpoint and delivery manifest from regular on-disk JSON files, reject duplicate keys and non-finite JSON constants in certified artifacts, compare caller-supplied payloads against disk before using them, and recompute exact artifact hashes even when a caller claims resume compatibility. V77 adds the same disk-authority rule to the direct delivery-manifest writer: best_certified_result is emitted only when the in-memory campaign_state is JSON-equivalent to the regular in-project campaign checkpoint selected by campaign_path. V78 closes the remaining manifest writer publication seam: best_certified_result may only be persisted by the canonical export writer to the regular in-project data/solutions/certified_delivery_manifest.json surface; raw direct writers and side output paths are not certified publication authority.

obligations.policy: All current proof-bearing strong-status source surfaces in the close-kernel scan roots are sealed by path, source_sha256, proof obligation, and guard tokens; new, unregistered, or drifted CERTIFIED / proof-bearing INFEASIBLE sinks fail closed until reviewed.

certified_cut_replay_contract.title: Exact-safe BendersCut replay must be strictly parsed and faithfully encoded by every certified master backend
obligations: Exact-safe certified cut JSON must be strict JSON with no duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, or truthy string coercion.
source_mode=certified_exact cuts must use strict bool exact_safe fields and strict integer conflict_set / condition_set payloads; bool is not an int for proof payloads.
Campaign resume and pre-master replay must reject malformed exact_safe cuts before inheriting certification state.
Every conflict member must resolve to a concrete master literal; unresolved members fail closed instead of being dropped.
Distinct conflict members must map one-to-one to distinct backend literals; alias collisions fail closed instead of deduping into a stronger cut.
Exact-safe cuts are registered, persisted, or counted only after the master backend accepts the whole cut.
Every non-empty certified condition_set must use a resolver-supported condition key grammar; unsupported keys fail closed before resume or replay.
Condition-required power-subproblem cuts must bind ghost_anchor condition keys to matching metadata.ghost_anchor and metadata.ghost_rect_idx values.
Condition-required ghost_anchor keys must be canonical non-negative decimal coordinates with no whitespace, signs, leading zero ambiguity, underscores, extra fields, or overflow-shaped values.
Campaign resume must validate every non-empty condition_set against the current candidate ghost domain, including the canonical rect-index enumeration used by master replay.
Certified campaign terminal evidence must require strict declare_mode; best_effort or candidate-subset campaigns must not export full-domain certified results.
Certified outer search must not skip UNKNOWN frontier candidates unless a separate partition/coverage proof exists and is machine-gated.
Certified delivery manifests must reject non-strict final_result inheritance rather than presenting best-effort state as certified delivery evidence.

Candidate-level CERTIFIED evidence is an incumbent only; final_result, final_solution, delivery manifests, and best_certified_result require a strict terminal stop with status CERTIFIED and reason search_exhausted_all_candidates.

Every certified ExactSearchSession construction path, including outer_search precheck and coordinator paths, must fail closed on master-domain-changing env/debug overrides before session construction.
Non-strict or best_effort resume states must fail closed before writing final_solution, final_result, or any other certified-looking terminal artifact.
Fail-closed certified outer blockers must remove stale final_solution and optimal_blueprint artifacts and refresh the certified delivery manifest before returning UNPROVEN.
Terminal certified state committed before export must be rolled back to UNPROVEN and partial artifacts purged if final_solution, optimal_blueprint, or manifest export fails.

Direct certified delivery manifest writes must verify that best_certified_result comes from the regular in-project disk checkpoint, not a caller-only memory campaign, and must publish it only through the canonical regular in-project certified_delivery_manifest.json surface.
certified_cut_replay_contract.policy: Certified cut replay is an all-or-nothing faithful-encoding boundary. Any partial, aliased, coerced, condition-unresolved, metadata-inconsistent, candidate-domain-inconsistent, non-strict declare_mode, candidate-subset, non-terminal incumbent, unsafe pre-session master-domain override, or post-hoc registered cut/result is not replay-safe and must not prune or certify search. Memory-only manifest authority is not a certified export source. Canonical manifest output, not an arbitrary output_path or low-level writer call, is the only certified delivery-manifest publication surface.

close_kernel_contract.policy: Small structural close kernel, not a theorem prover. It prevents the close proof from becoming a new dark hallway by sealing proof-bearing strong-status sinks and central guard tokens.
